card.name: Words after 'including' and 'subject to'
card.fires_on: The word 'fatal' right after 'including' in lactic acidosis warnings, and 'as' after 'subject to change' or 'performed' in policy or requirement phrases. Weaker on scattered other words.

modes.label: Fatal cases
modes.description: The word 'fatal' introducing reported cases in a warning about lactic acidosis and liver enlargement.
modes.example: Lactic acidosis and severe hepatomegaly with steatosis, including<< fatal>> cases, have been reported with the use

modes.label: As per / as required
modes.description: The word 'as' leading into a policy or authority clause after 'change' or 'performed'.
modes.example: Course fee is non-refundable but transferrable to another course or participant and subject to change<< as>> per UNITAR's policy on pricing.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are Chinese phrases about necessity and timing, so there is no clear link to the English contexts.
card.plain: It lights up on 'fatal' in 'including fatal cases' warnings and on 'as' in 'subject to change as per' phrases.
